data.description: Full event object in Astro-COLIBRI's native JSON format, exactly as published on the astrocolibri.important.JSON Kafka topic (the fields /get_event returns; see https://astro-colibri.science/apidoc#voevent_section). The AT Protocol data model has no floating-point numbers, so every float is written as a string wrapped in № markers (for example "№182.6365№"), the convention of the nebra package, whose stream decodes them back to floats. Integers, booleans, strings and nulls are unchanged. The payload is intentionally open to preserve event-specific fields.

broker.description: Broker, classifier, or service that submitted the event. Known values come from the general filter, plus GCN and TNS as emitted by the listeners. An empty string means unspecified; additional brokers are allowed.

alertType.description: Event or source type used by Astro-COLIBRI. Includes transient classes, catalogue source classes, and tilepy observation tiles. Known values retain the spelling used by the filters and listeners; additional values are allowed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this AT Protocol alert record was created, including a timezone (prefer UTC with a Z suffix). This is distinct from the event detection time in data.

important.description: Whether this alert qualifies for the Astro-COLIBRI important stream. This is separate from the VOEvent Why.importance value. See https://astro-colibri.science/brokerdoc#important for the criteria.

triggerID.description: Trigger identifier used by Astro-COLIBRI for the event, matching data.trigger_id in the native JSON payload.

instrument.description: Instrument or analysis that detected or localized the event, when known. Additional instruments are allowed.

observatory.description: Discovery observatory, experiment, or source catalogue. Known values include filter labels and spellings emitted by the listeners; additional observatories are allowed.

astroColibriID.description: Unique event identifier assigned by Astro-COLIBRI. It identifies the same event across revisions and payload formats.

main.description: Astro-COLIBRI alert with the full event in Astro-COLIBRI's native JSON format. Astro-COLIBRI publishes one science.astro-colibri.alert.ac and one science.astro-colibri.alert.vo2 record per alert on its important stream, under the same record key, so the two can be paired. See https://astro-colibri.science/atprotodoc. Use of the data is subject to the Astro-COLIBRI terms of use, which allow non-commercial use only: https://astro-colibri.science/tos#data-usage.
